proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_option_restriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation surface can represent the shared charge pool, fixed save DC, dawn recharge, last-charge destruction, and Fear's 60-foot cone via area override. It cannot honestly express that casts of Command granted by this item are restricted to only specific command-word branches of the underlying spell.

notes: No content file authored. The item otherwise fits the existing magic-item activation pattern: holding-item gate, charge_pool 7, dawn regain 1d6+1, last_charge_roll destruction, fixed DC 15, and Fear areaOverride to a 60-foot cone.
